title: UE radio capability ID deletion indication

entities.name: UE radio capability ID deletion indication
entities.description: Information element that may be included to trigger UE deletion of network-assigned UE radio capability IDs for the serving PLMN or SNPN.

entities.name: UE not in NB-N1 mode
entities.description: Condition that the UE is not operating in NB-N1 mode.

entities.name: UE and network support RACS
entities.description: Condition that both the UE and network support RACS (Radio Access Capability Signaling).

entities.name: Network needs to trigger UE radio capability ID deletion
entities.description: Condition that the network needs to trigger the UE to delete stored network-assigned UE radio capability IDs.

entities.name: Delete network-assigned UE radio capability IDs
entities.description: Property where the UE deletes all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs stored for the serving PLMN or serving SNPN.

relations.description: The inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that the UE is not in NB-N1 mode.
The inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that both UE and network support RACS.
The inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that the network needs to trigger UE radio capability ID deletion.
The IE establishes the property that the UE deletes all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs for the serving PLMN or SNPN.
